study tips that will actually
improve your grades

1. start the night before the night before

review a little two days early.
the night before is just a recap.

2. do the practice questions first

then read the chapter.
you'll know exactly what to look for.

3. rewrite your notes in fewer words

half a page per lesson.
if it doesn't fit, you don't get it yet.

4. ask one question per class

teachers remember the students who care.

5. check what you got wrong

your mistakes on the last test
are the best study guide you'll ever have.
save this for your next exam.
